scope: ODA §24.2.2.3-24.2.2.3.1 DataStorage direct/blob threshold and Blob01 page size/count limits

sourceAuthority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
rules: Direct byte arrays are at most 0x40000 bytes; larger arrays use a blob reference.
A blob reference names one or more Blob01 pages.
Each Blob01 page payload is at most 0xFFFB0 bytes.
The blob descriptor and each page header redundantly encode sizes/counts/offsets; assembled page data must equal total data size.

changes.detail: Named the ODA 0xFFFB0 Blob01 page payload maximum.

Rejects blob descriptors at/below the direct-record limit, zero pages, invalid nominal/final page sizes, zero-length pages, and individual referenced page lengths above 0xFFFB0. Existing checked page sum and metadata closure remain.

Expands the generated in-memory two-page reversed-physical-order blob to exactly two maximum-size pages (2 MiB total), and adds over-limit page, under-threshold blob, and zero-page negatives with suffix-preservation assertions.
